notes.title: v1.2 out now!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! FVS, the solo dev of Towerful Defense: A Rogue TD, here. And The First Expansion is LIVE!

After months of development, I'm very excited to finally share this major update with you all. 

If you already owned the game, just hit update and enjoy!

And if you haven't picked it up yet, now's the perfect time as It's 30% off.

Check out the trailer below for a sneak peek, and then take a look at the full list of major content and features. Let me know what you think!

[previewyoutube=iPYNd-vACs8;full][/previewyoutube]

NEW GAME MODE: Manual Skill, you can not use Auto Skill
NEW GAME MODE: Turret Control, manually control the tower’s turret
NEW TOWER: HOTR, hold fire button to shoot tower bullets, the tower can be overheated
NEW TOWER: LCK
NEW CARD:  Luck Crafter
NEW CARD: Fate Defiance
NEW CARD: Second Chance
NEW ENEMIES: Explosive
NEW: Talent Point spending screen
NEW: combat music, menu music
NEW: enemy’s health bar
NEW: home screen’s effect
NEW: different spawn point for Meteor enemies
NEW: display the amount of money you get after destroying an enemy
NEW: effects for projectiles
NEW: lighting effect and animation for Land Mines and Timer Bombs
NEW: lighting effect for Air Blade
NEW: lighting effect for support units
REBALANCED: Bosses and elite enemies can’t be frozen while touching the tower
REBALANCED: destroying bigger enemies now gets more money
REBALANCED: destroying Bosses and elite enemies in endless waves won’t guarantee rare supply boxes
REBALANCED: LBBB card
REBALANCED: new initial Critical Bonus is 2x (previous rate was 1.5x)
FIXED: controller button prompts on Steam Deck
IMPROVED: Auto Skill screen
IMPROVED: change Critical Factor to Critical Bonus
IMPROVED: the tower’s short range is now clearer
OPTIMIZED: small enemies’ rendering

[i]Get Towerful Defense: A Rogue TD now![/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2453610/Towerful_Defense_A_Rogue_TD/

notes.title: v1.1.17 update notes
notes.content:
Hello, towerful defenders!

Thank you for your support, I’m still working hard to improve the game according to your feedback and add new content, features that I think you’ll love.

There’s more coming, and here are update notes for the latest version, v1.1.17.

- NEW: when your skills cost the tower's HP, the skills' cards now display exactly how much HP they cost
- NEW: tower Invt, it has a twist on tower bullet damage
- NEW: artifact ELYM
- NEW: Auto skill interval is now more precise with 0.2 second step
- NEW: custom Endless mode, now you can choose which cursed items you'll get in the Endless mode, you can choose to get none of them.
- REBALANCED: Mother Ship spawns less meteors in first Hostilities
- REBALANCED: limit effective % Money at 500%
- REBALANCED: limit effective Luck at 100
- REBALANCED: HISF now also -1 Max HP
- REBALANCED: NDLS now also -1 Armor
- REBALANCED: remove Blind Bless, BEEM, MASS (in that order) after wave 39, 49, 59
- REBALANCED: add Endless Curse I after wave 69
- REBALANCED: max chance a Glitchy appears is now 35%
- REBALANCED: skill enhancements will appear less after wave 19
- REBALANCED: enemies' HPs will grow significantly faster after wave 35
- IMPROVED: Dormant Power's English description (thanks, Hank Hill on Discord)

[i]If you love the game, please leave me a review on Steam, it is huge motivation that helps me to continue working on the game and deliver more content.[/i]

notes.title: Road Map 1.0
notes.content:
[h2]👋 Hello towerful defenders.[/h2]

Our launch was a success! [b]Towerful Defense: A Rogue TD[/b] made it to Steam's [b]New and Trending[/b] list and stayed there for almost 2 days. It was something that I obviously couldn't achieve without [b]your support[/b].

I'm so thankful for the journey we've had so far, and I'm here to tell you that it's far from over.

[h2]🎯 Here's what's coming next:[/h2]

[b]Quality of life updates:[/b] first we have to polish even more we already have. These update will include bug fixes, new features that improve the game's experience, new tutorials for players who are not familiar with the genre,...

[b]Free content:[/b] new towers, skills, items that will make you explore more playstyles. Free content are made possible, again, because of your support.

[b]Trading cards:[/b] for players who love collectibles, here's good news, Towerful Defense: A Rogue TD is now allowed by Steam to drop Trading cards, if you've played the game more than 2 hours, you'll see them in your inventories soon.

[h2]📝 Leave a review[/h2]

If you haven't yet, this should be the time to tell other people about how you think of the game by leaving it a [b]review on the game's page[/b]. That also helps me A LOT!

Hope you all enjoy the game. See you next time!

[url=https://discord.gg/7bR9rhZ6qU][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44215685/acbaa3b386ff9fe655980352e804d41a5cdec037.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: OUT NOW 🎉
notes.content:
[h3][b]HELLO, "TOWERFUL" DEFENDERS OF EARTH 🌍[/b][/h3]
The wait is finally over ⌚ 
[b]Towerful Defense: A Rogue TD[/b] is now officially [b]released[/b] 🎉

That also means the [b]aliens are coming[/b] 👾👾👽👾👾👽👾👾👽
And it's time to [b]put your best strategy to the test[/b] 🧠🤯

In, this post I will briefly show you [b]what to expect[/b] ✨ from the game and what's the [b]best way to get[/b] it 💰

[h3][b]FIRST, LET'S WATCH THE LAUNCH TRAILER 📽️[/b][/h3]
[previewyoutube=Zx6G06EFEtU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]SO, IF YOU'VE PLAYED THE DEMO 🪧[/b][/h3]
here are [b]features [/b]and [b]contents [/b]you can [b]only [/b]experience [b]in the full version[/b]:

💥 MORE POWER IN YOUR HAND: more [b]towers[/b], and [b]skills [/b]to start a run with. Skills have more [b]traits[/b]. And a lot more [b]items [/b]that give you endless combinations. Prepare to go very wild!

🏋️ MORE CHALLENGES: you can now fight the final [b]boss [/b]in the demo till the end of the wave. And that's just the start. As you unlock more [b]Hostilities[/b], enemies will grow [b]stronger[/b], new [b]normal enemies[/b] and [b]elite[/b] enemies appear, and you'll have your [b]ultimate boss fight[/b] at the highest Hostility. And that's not all, you can make a run [b]endless[/b] and face a whole new set of challenges to test the durability of your builds. Let's see how far you can go!

🏆 YOUR [b]ACHIEVEMENTS[/b] WON'T GO UNNOTICED: let everyone know about your epic victories, and the skills you are able to pull by showcasing them on your Steam profile.

🎮 ENHANCED EXPERIENCE: in the full version, you'll get access to many features that add joy to your play, like [b]Story scenes, Combat speed, Custom difficulty, improved performance[/b],...

[i]And of course, free future updates with quality of life and minor additional content are already planned.[/i]

[h3][b]CHOOSE YOUR BEST DEAL 🤝[/b][/h3]

😎 The game is currently at an [b]18% discount[/b] and it will last for only 2 weeks. But it is not the only discount you can have right now. Towerful Defense: A Rogue TD [b]is bundling with many other cool games[/b] that you would love to check out, and if you decide to buy them together, or you already own ones, you can enjoy [b]another discount[/b]!

🤗 If you want to support me with the future development of this game and more you can buy the [b]Supporter bundle[/b] below:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/43062/

[h3][b]LEAVE ME A REVIEW 📝[/b][/h3]

📢 Another way to support me is to leave your [b]honest review[/b] about the game on Steam, tell people what you love about it and your suggestions for improvement (and it could be added to the next updates).

[h3][b]FOR MORE DISCUSSION AND SUPPORT 🛟[/b][/h3]

please visit the Discord server:
[url=https://discord.gg/7bR9rhZ6qU][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44215685/acbaa3b386ff9fe655980352e804d41a5cdec037.png[/img][/url]

[i]Thank you for your support during the development of the game, and your purchase. I hope you'll enjoy it 💖[/i]

notes.title: Next Fest Demo Update
notes.content:
Steam Next Fest is in June, and [b]Towerful Defense: A Rogue TD[/b] is going to be proudly part of the event.

To celebrate, It's time for the demo's big update, a whole new system: [b]Talent Points[/b]. You earn Talent Points by beating certain waves and you get to keep the points permanently. You can use the points to straight buy main stats or to use with new cards that leverage the points.

Try it yourself now, and don't forget to add the game to your wishlist as the launch day is coming closer!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2453610/Towerful_Defense_A_Rogue_TD/
